pool.arabic: بأول أسبوع بلندن صارت لي صدمة ثقافية.
pool.arabicTashkeel: بأوَّل أسبوع بلَندَن صارَت لي صَدمة ثَقافية.
pool.english: In my first week in London I had culture shock.
pool.transliteration: b-awwal usboo3 b-landan saarat li sadma thagaafiyya.

pool.english: Respect for elders is very important in the Gulf.
In Germany, punctuality is very important.
Their food was strange for me.
It took me months to adapt.
Expatriates are the majority in Dubai.
What's the difference between the two cultures?

pool.arabic: في تشابه كبير بين الأكل الخليجي واليمني.
pool.arabicTashkeel: في تَشابُه كْبير بين الأكل الخَليجي واليَمَني.
pool.english: There's a big similarity between Gulf and Yemeni food.
pool.transliteration: fee tashaabuh chbeer been il-akl il-khaleeji w-il-yamani.

pool.arabic: بالخليج عيب ترفض القهوة من المعزب.
pool.arabicTashkeel: بالخَليج عيب تِرفُض القَهوة مِن المِعزِّب.
pool.english: In the Gulf, it's shameful to refuse coffee from your host.
Culture shock is normal at first.

pool.arabic: عادات الأعراس فيها فرق بكل مكان.
pool.arabicTashkeel: عادات الأعراس فيها فَرق بكِل مَكان.

pool.english: In the Gulf, men greet each other by touching noses.
In the Gulf, punctuality is sometimes flexible.

pool.arabic: غريب إن المحلات تسكر العصر هني.
pool.arabicTashkeel: غَريب إنَّ المَحَلّات تسَكِّر العَصر هِني.
pool.english: It's strange that shops close in the afternoon here.
pool.transliteration: ghareeb inna il-ma7allaat tsakkir il-3asr hini.

pool.english: I compared prices in both countries.
What's the difference between Dubai and Doha?
There are similarities in the dialects.
The foreigner was surprised by the hospitality.
Gulf children are polite with guests.

pool.arabic: وافدين من أكثر من ميتين دولة.
pool.arabicTashkeel: وافدين مِن أكثَر مِن مِيتين دَولة.
pool.english: Expatriates from more than two hundred countries.
pool.transliteration: waafdeen min akthar min meetain dawla.

pool.english: The difference is in the details.
It's shameful to show the sole of your foot in the majlis.
Punctuality is a sign of respect.

sentences.english: My cousin studies in Germany on a scholarship.

sentences.arabic: بالبداية صارت له صدمة ثقافية: الناس صريحين وايد، والإلتزام بالمواعيد صارم.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالبِداية صارَت لَه صَدمة ثَقافية: النّاس صَريحين وايد، والإلتِزام بالمَواعيد صارِم.
sentences.english: At first he had culture shock: people were very direct, and punctuality was very strict.
sentences.transliteration: bil-bidaaya saarat la sadma thagaafiyya: in-naas saree7een waayid, w-il-iltizaam bil-mawaa3eed saarim.

sentences.arabic: بالخليج إذا الضيف تأخر، ما عليه؛ بألمانيا غريب.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالخَليج إذا الضَّيف تأخَّر، ما عَليه؛ بألمانيا غَريب.
sentences.english: In the Gulf, if a guest comes late, it's no problem; in Germany it's strange.
sentences.transliteration: bil-khaleej idha idh-dhaif t2akhkhar, ma 3alee; b-almaanya ghareeb.

sentences.arabic: بس قارن الثقافتين ولقى تشابه: الإثنين يحترمون العايلة والتعليم.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَس قارَن الثَّقافتين ولِقى تَشابُه: الإثنين يِحتِرمون العايلة والتَّعليم.
sentences.english: But he compared the two cultures and found similarities: both respect family and education.
sentences.transliteration: bas gaaran ith-thagaafatain w-liga tashaabuh: il-ithnain yi7tirmoon il-3aayla w-it-ta3leem.

sentences.arabic: بعد سنتين تأقلم، بس بعده مشتاق للتحية والضيافة الخليجية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَعد سَنتين تأقلَم، بَس بَعدَه مِشتاق للتَّحية والضِّيافة الخَليجية.
sentences.english: After two years he adapted, but he still misses the Gulf greeting and hospitality.
sentences.transliteration: ba3d santain t2aglam, bas ba3ada mishtaag lit-ta7iyya w-idh-dhiyaafa il-khaleejiyya.

passages.title: Advice for Foreigners in the Gulf

sentences.arabic: إذا زرت بيت خليجي، إقبل القهوة؛ الرفض عيب.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إذا زِرت بيت خَليجي، إقبَل القَهوة؛ الرَّفض عيب.
sentences.english: If you visit a Gulf home, accept the coffee; refusing is considered shameful.
sentences.transliteration: idha zirt beet khaleeji, igbal il-gahwa; ir-rafdh 3eeb.

sentences.arabic: خلك مؤدب ويا الكبار، وسلم على الكل لين تدش.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: خَلّك مْؤَدَّب وِيّا الكِبار، وسَلِّم على الكِل لَين تِدِش.
sentences.english: Be polite with elders, and greet everyone when you enter.
sentences.transliteration: khallak m2addab wiyya il-chbaar, w-sallim 3ala il-kill lain tidish.

sentences.arabic: إحترم العادات، وبتكون حياك بكل مكان.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إحتَرِم العادات، وبِتكون حَيّاك بكِل مَكان.
sentences.english: Respect the customs, and you will be welcome everywhere.

scenario.situation: The student, a newly arrived expat in Abu Dhabi, asks an Emirati colleague about local customs before attending a majlis for the first time.
scenario.studentRole: A new expat learning Gulf Arabic.
scenario.otherRole: The Emirati colleague, who explains what is polite and what is shameful.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask about greetings, punctuality and taboos, describe your own culture, and compare the similarities and differences.
